mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (film_id, score, comment, user_id, time, type) VALUES (#{filmId}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{userId}, #{time}, #{type})
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET film_id = #{filmId}, score = #{score}, comment = #{comment}, user_id = #{userId}, time = #{time}, type = #{type} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT comment.*, film.name as filmName, user.name as userName FROM comment LEFT JOIN film ON comment.film_id = film.id LEFT JOIN user ON comment.user_id = user.id
AND comment.user_id = #{userId}
AND film.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filmName}, '%')
AND comment.type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{type}, '%')
AND comment.film_Id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filmId}, '%')
ORDER BY comment.id DESC
